subject: Actual Qwen causal-conv parity PASS; require whole-model nonmutating A/B before training
body: Lane B reviewed the completed actual-dimension parity result against the prospectively committed gates. PASS is earned: channels8192,width4,bias=False,BF16 across seq17/64/128/512; forward relative-L2 ~0.00287-0.00289, grad_x ~0.00269-0.00271, grad_weight ~0.00254-0.00264, update_output ~0.00278-0.00299; cosine ~0.999996; cache update exact; no failures. This clears kernel-level actual-topology parity only. Hostile next gate: do not mutate weights with fla_triton_full yet. First run a whole-model non-optimizer backward/performance A/B using the same base, same fixed rows/seed/batching: control backend fla_triton (FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv) versus candidate fla_triton_full (FLA gated-delta + FLA causal-conv). Compare exact loss, finite trainable gradients, gradient digest/norm/direction, elapsed backward time, and peak VRAM. Only if whole-model gradient parity survives and the candidate materially improves runtime without memory regression should we authorize a bounded BNB8 optimizer step under fla_triton_full.
